subject: Catalyst evaluation — scope, success markers & next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ng <alex@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst evaluation — scope, success markers & next steps

Hi Alex,

Great to chat this morning — appreciate the context on the search/assistant use case and the evaluation constraints. Quick recap and the suggested plan so we can lock owners and dates: 

1) Goal & success markers (what we agreed)
- Precision: canonical answer rate >= 78% on the 150-item benchmark set you described.
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end generation < 850ms for typical 512-token prompts.
- Cost: projected per-1000 token cost <= your target of $0.35 (we'll validate once we have sample load).

2) Evaluation plan (high level)
- Week 0 (kickoff): share MAP and success criteria (attached: Catalyst_Success_Criteria.xlsx) + environment access for test dataset.
- Week 1–2: ingest sample dataset, run baseline runs, collect metrics.
- Week 3: joint review of results and tuning recommendations.

3) Timeline & owners
- Kickoff session: Tues, 29 Jun, 11:00am PT (proposed) — owner: Alex / Dana (Catalyst), Redwood owner: Ben Carter.
- Data handoff: by Fri, 2 Jul — owner: Dana Li (Catalyst).
- Baseline results: by Fri, 9 Jul — owner: Monica Patel (Redwood).

4) Asks (quick)
- Please confirm the kickoff slot or propose an alternate.
- Confirm Dana as data owner and who will fill the small "owner" column in the attached MAP file.
- Share a sample of the benchmark set (anonymized) so we can pre-spin runs.

Attachments: Catalyst_Success_Criteria.xlsx (xlsx) — I added a short checklist and an "owner" column.

I'll follow up with a formal MAP and a DocuSign placeholder for the standard trial agreement once we confirm the kickoff date.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference — inference that scales predictably

Two small clarifications:
